# Causality check: same ACT runs with torchao uninstalled in the run's container, so DataLoader
# workers no longer open a HIP context through transformers -> torchao -> has_triton(). GPUs 0-3.
notorchao-act-1g-w8|act-base|0|1|--batch_size=32 --steps=60 --log_freq=20 --save_freq=100000 --dataset.episodes=null --num_workers=8|pip uninstall -y -q torchao;;python3 -c "import torch; from lerobot.datasets import LeRobotDataset; print('NO_TORCHAO cuda_initialized_after_dataset_import', torch.cuda.is_initialized())";;export MIOPEN_USER_DB_PATH=/outputs/rocm-train/miopen/fast/db;;export MIOPEN_CUSTOM_CACHE_DIR=/outputs/rocm-train/miopen/fast/cache
